subject: How to get bigger dots in point legends

messages.author: 96b171d2e941ddba
messages.subject: How to get bigger dots in point legends
parts:
If I use geom="jitter" and have lots of points, I need to use a small
point size to see them. But this also makes the dot in the color legend
small, so it is impossible to identify the colors in the legend,
especially for the default pastel-like palette. Is there a way to
override the legend? For example, the "bar" legend would work nicely.

Thanks.
Jim Rome

messages.author: fc22cb727156ff4f
messages.subject: Re: How to get bigger dots in point legends
parts:
On Fri, Jun 10, 2011 at 20:49, James Rome <jame...@gmail.com> wrote:
> If I use geom="jitter" and have lots of points, I need to use a small
> point size to see them. But this also makes the dot in the color legend
> small, so it is impossible to identify the colors in the legend,
> especially for the default pastel-like palette. Is there a way to
> override the legend? For example, the "bar" legend would work nicely.

You can use the hack I mentioned in the thread "Very low alpha values
suppress visibility in Legend" earlier today:
- map size to a constant
- use scale_size(to=c(0.1, 0.1), legend=FALSE)
the points on the graph will be small but the points in the legend
will have their regular size.

JiHO
